intro: You will integrate short sources using paraphrase and attribution, keeping differences and limits.

texto: Group common ideas and differences; paraphrase the wording and point to the source. Use a short quotation only when the exact wording matters. Say what the material does not allow you to conclude; don't combine figures if they measure different populations or periods.

frases.estudio: Bibliotekets rapport sier at 62 prosent av de 120 som svarte, foretrekker papirbøker til lengre tekster. Et lesesenter fikk svar fra 85 personer og fant at 54 prosent velger papir til studier, mens 38 prosent foretrekker skjerm. Begge undersøkelsene brukte frivillig deltakelse, men utvalgene og spørsmålene var ulike.
frases.alumno: The library's report says that around 62% of the 120 people who responded prefer printed books for long texts. A reading centre received responses from 85 people and observed that around 54% chose paper for studying, while around 38% preferred reading on screen. Both studies used voluntary participation, but the samples and the questions were different.

pregunta.texto: What limitation do the two surveys share?

opciones.explicacion: Both surveys were based on voluntary participation.

opciones.texto: They had the same sample size

opciones.explicacion: The text says the questions were different.

pregunta.texto: Write a short synthesis of both sources with attribution and a limitation that prevents generalising without caution.

textos: Bibliotekets rapport viser at 62 prosent av respondentene foretrekker papir til lange tekster. Lesesenteret fant at 54 prosent velger papir til studier. Svarene kan ikke sammenlignes direkte fordi spørsmål og utvalg var ulike, og deltakelsen var frivillig.

piezas.explicacion: Model: attribute percentages and explain why they are not directly compared.
